# SUPPURATIVE THROMBOPHLEBITIS - EMPIRICAL THERAPY

Obtain blood cultures before starting empirical antimicrobials.

Peripheral vein suppurative thrombophlebitis may require surgical intervention

in addition to antimicrobial therapy. The usual treatment for jugular vein

suppurative thrombophlebitis (Lemierre's syndrome) and vena cava suppurative

thrombophlebitis is prolonged antimicrobial therapy, with or without

radiological or thrombolytic clot removal. Consult Infectious Diseases and

Vascular Surgery for more information.

Modify antimicrobial regimen and narrow coverage based on results of culture and

susceptibility tests.

# Duration of therapy

A minimum of 4 to 6 weeks of antimicrobial therapy is appropriate and may be

abbreviated in peripheral vein infections based on patient specific factors.

Antimicrobial therapy should be continued until there is definite clinical

response and oral antimicrobial therapy may be used after completion of initial

course of intravenous therapy.

# Empirical treatment for peripheral vein infections and central vein infections

# associated with a venous catheter

Preferred:

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R <AND> ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h \($\) M](orz-set-abx-vanc-15-mg-kg-iv-q12h-ceftriax-2-gm-iv-q24h)

Alternative:

[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction CLICK HERE](orzid2-gmenu-abx-beta-lactam-allergy-assesment)

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R <AND> gentamicin 5 mg/kg IV q24h \($\)](orz-set-abx-vanco-15-mg-kg-iv-q12h-gent-5-mg-kg-iv-q24h)

[R,O]

# Empirical treatment for jugular vein infection (also known as Lemierre's) or

# suppurative pelvic vein infection

Consultation with Surgery and Infectious Diseases is encouraged.

Preferred:

[Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h \($$\) R](psjizid-pip-taz-4-5gm-iv-q6h-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro)

Alternative:

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h \($\) M <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h \($\) DI](orz-set-abx-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h-metron-500mg-iv-q8h)

# For catheter-associated infection, add vancomycin to one of the above treatment

# regimens

[< ADD > Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R](orz-set-abx-vanco-new-start-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)
